SELECT DISTINCT
    r.proj_id project_id,
    proj.description Project_Title,
    r.r_id,
    r.r_code requisition_no,
    r_nls.short_desc Req_Short_Desc,
    r_nls.Description Req_Desc,
    r.r_supp req_rev,
    r.created_date req_created_date,
    r.rel_to_proc_date released_to_proc,
    r.approved_date req_approved_date,
    r.proc_acknowledge_date proc_ack_date
FROM
  m_sys.m_reqs r, 
  m_sys.m_req_nls r_nls,
  m_sys.m_projects proj
WHERE 1=1
  AND r.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
  AND r.proj_id = proj.proj_id
  AND r.r_code like '%MR%'
  AND r.actual_ind = 'N'
  AND r.r_supp = '0'
  AND r.r_id = r_nls.r_id
  AND r_nls.nls_id = 1
ORDER BY project_id, r.r_code

      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MP_FAB_LOCATION') MP_FAB_LOCATION,

     m_sys.m_pck_bom.list_path_to_root (ln.ln_id, '/') bom_path, -- added latter
	 --below added later
	  MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'ITEM_TYPE') POS_ITR,
      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'MAIN_CONN_NUM') MAIN_CONN_NUM,

      MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_LP_ATTR_VALUE(lp.lp_id,'RED_CONN_TYPE') REDUCED_CONN_TYPE,

    WHERE lp.dp_id    = (SELECT dp_id FROM m_sys.m_disciplines WHERE dp_code = 'PIPING')
    AND   ln.proj_id  = lp.proj_id
    AND   ln.ln_id    = lp.ln_id
    AND   lp.stat_id  = ms.stat_id
    AND   lp.ident    = inn.ident
    AND   lp.lst_id   = lst.lst_id
    AND   lp.spec_header_id = sh.spec_header_id(+)
    AND (sh.spr_id = (SELECT MAX(spr_id)
                      FROM m_sys.m_spec_headers sh2
                      WHERE sh2.proj_id = lp.proj_id
                      AND  sh.spec_code  = sh2.spec_code) OR sh.spr_id is NULL)
   AND ln.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}') o1,
    (SELECT *
     FROM (
         SELECT ln.ln_id, ln.proj_id,
                MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DISCIPLINE') discipline,
                MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'TYPE') Type,
                (Case When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'UNIT') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'UNIT')
                When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'MODULE') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'MODULE')
                When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'GROUP') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'GROUP')
                else '' END) Unit_module_group,
                (Case When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'AREA') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'AREA')
                When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'CWA') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'CWA')
                When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DECK') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DECk')
                else '' END) Area_cwa_deck,
               -- MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'ELEMENT') Element,
			   (Case When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'ELEMENT')is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'ELEMENT')
                      When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'P_LINE')is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'P_LINE')
                 ELSE '' END) Element,
                (Case When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'BOM')is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'BOM')
                      When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DRAWING_NO') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'DRAWING_NO')
					  When MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'SPOOL') is not null then MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_DYNAMIC_MAX_NODE_INFO(ln.ln_id,'SPOOL')
                ELSE '' END) Bom_drawing_no
         FROM m_sys.m_list_nodes ln
         WHERE 1=1
         AND ln.proj_id = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
         AND ln.ln_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT ln_id FROM m_sys.m_list_pos lp1 WHERE lp1.dp_id IN (SELECT dp_id FROM m_sys.m_disciplines WHERE dp_code IN ('PIPING')))
         )
    ) o2
WHERE o1.ln_id   = o2.ln_id
AND   o1.proj_id = o2.proj_id
AND   o1.stat_id  = MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_BEST_QUANTITY(o1.proj_id,o1.dp_id, o1.ln_id) -- filter by Best Quantity
ORDER BY discipline, type, Unit_module_group, Area_cwa_deck, Element,Bom_drawing_no, TO_NUMBER(pos)

SELECT DISTINCT
    poh.proj_id project_id,
    proj.description Project_Title,
    r.r_id,
    r.r_code requisition_no,
    r_nls.short_desc Req_Short_Desc,
    r_nls.Description Req_Desc,
    r.r_supp req_rev,
    TO_CHAR(r.created_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') req_created_date,
    TO_CHAR(r.rel_to_proc_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') released_to_proc,
    TO_CHAR(r.approved_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') req_approved_date,
    TO_CHAR(r.proc_acknowledge_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') proc_ack_date,
    poh.po_number,
    poh.po_supp po_rev,
    (SELECT description from m_sys.m_po_header_nls WHERE poh_id=poh.poh_id AND nls_id=1 AND ROWNUM<2) po_title,
    MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_PO_STATUS(poh.poh_id, 'N') po_status,
    MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_PO_STATUS_DATE(poh.poh_id, 'N') status_date,
    TO_CHAR(poh.approved_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_approved_date,
    TO_CHAR(poh.po_issue_date, 'DD-MON-YYYY') po_issue_date,
    ROUND(tc.total_price+NVL(tc.tax_amount,0),2) total_cost_po,
    (SELECT unit_code FROM m_sys.m_units WHERE unit_id=poh.currency_id AND ROWNUM<2) currency_po,
    ROUND(MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_AMOUNT_USD(r.proj_id, SYSDATE,tc.currency_id,(tc.total_price+NVL(tc.tax_amount,0))),2) total_in_usd,
    (SELECT company_name FROM m_sys.m_companies WHERE company_id=ms.company_id AND ROWNUM<2) supplier_name,
    ms.sup_code supplier_code,
    (SELECT description FROM m_sys.m_country_nls WHERE cy_id=ms.cy_id AND nls_id=1 AND ROWNUM<2) supplier_location,
    (SELECT job_number  FROM m_sys.m_jobs WHERE job_id=poh.job_id AND ROWNUM<2) account_code_po
FROM
    m_sys.m_reqs r,
    m_sys.m_req_nls r_nls,
    m_sys.m_po_headers poh,
    m_sys.m_projects proj,
    m_sys.m_po_total_costs tc,
    m_sys.m_overview_suppliers ms,
    (SELECT r_id, poh_id
        FROM
        (
          SELECT DISTINCT min_r_id r_id, min_poh_id poh_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY base_poh_id ORDER BY min_r_id DESC) row_num
          FROM 
          (
              SELECT MIN(get_r.r_id) min_r_id, MIN(poh.poh_id) min_poh_id, poh.base_poh_id
                FROM
                  (SELECT r.r_id, CONNECT_BY_ROOT r_id as this_is_root
                    FROM m_sys.m_reqs r
                       WHERE r.proj_id  = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
                          AND r.actual_ind = 'Y'
                          AND r.approved_date is not null  --TR
                          START WITH last_r_id IS NULL
                          CONNECT BY last_r_id = PRIOR r.r_id
                  ) get_r,
                   m_sys.m_req_to_pos rp,
                   m_sys.m_po_headers poh
          WHERE rp.proj_id     = '@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}'
                AND   rp.proj_id = poh.proj_id
                AND   rp.rli_id IS NULL
                AND   ( rp.rli_id IS NULL AND poh.order_type <> 'SC' OR poh.order_type = 'SC')
                AND   rp.r_id        = get_r.r_id
                AND   rp.base_poh_id = poh.base_poh_id
                AND m_sys.m_pck_config_custom.mdr_get_po_status(poh.poh_id) <> 'CANCELLED'  -- remove cancelled POs
                GROUP BY this_is_root, poh.base_poh_id
          )
          )
          WHERE row_num < 31) req_po
      WHERE poh.proj_id = r.proj_id
      AND poh.proj_id = proj.proj_id
      AND r.r_id = r_nls.r_id
      AND r_nls.nls_id = 1
      AND r.r_id        = req_po.r_id
      AND r.actual_ind = 'Y'
      AND poh.poh_id    = req_po.poh_id
      AND poh.sup_id    = ms.sup_id(+)
      AND poh.poh_id    = tc.poh_id(+)
ORDER BY project_id, po_number

  (select min(PO_issue_date) from  m_sys.m_po_headers where base_poh_id = poh.base_poh_id) Rev0_Issue_Date,
   decode (poh.payment_type,'MP','Milestone Progress','SV','Schedule of Value','MQ','Measured Qty',poh.payment_type) Payment_Type,---+++
  MAW.ATTP_ORDER_SEQ PPE_Seq_Nr, MAW.ATTP_DSP_PPE_CODE Prog_Pay_Event, MAW.ATTP_DSP_SHORT_DESC Short_Desc,replace(MAW.ATTP_DSP_DESCRIPTION,'|', ' ') Description, MAW.ATTP_PLAN_COMPLETION_DATE Planned_Completion_Date,
  MAW.ATTP_PAYMENT_PERCENT Prog_Pay_Percent, 
  nvl(MAW.ATTP_COST_VALUE,0)  Cost_value,
  nvl(MDR_CUST.MDR_REPORT_CUSTOM.GET_AMOUNT_USD(POH.Proj_id, SYSDATE,POH.Currency_id,MAW.ATTP_COST_VALUE),0)  Cost_value_USD,
  MAW.ATTP_PAYMENT_WEEKS PW, MAW.ATTP_PAYMENT_DATE Pred_Pay_Date, MAW.ATTP_ACTUAL_PAYMENT_DATE Actual_Pay_Date,MAW.ATTP_PAID_IND Paid,
  trunc(MAW.ATTP_PAYMENT_DATE) - trunc(sysdate) Credit_days,
  (select max(attv.short_desc) from M_Sys.M_Used_Values Uv, M_Sys.M_Attrs Att, m_sys.m_attr_values attv
     Where  Uv.Proj_Id    = poh.proj_id
      And   Uv.Attr_Id    = Att.Attr_Id
      And   Att.Attr_Code = 'PAYMENT_MODE'
      And   Uv.Pk_Id      = poh.poh_id
      And   Uv.Used_Type  = 'PO'
      And   Attv.attr_value = Uv.attr_value
      And   Rownum < 2) Payment_Mode_Oracle,
  (select max(attv.short_desc)
    From M_Sys.M_Used_Values Uv, M_Sys.M_Attrs Att, m_sys.m_attr_values attv
    Where Uv.Proj_Id    = poh.proj_id
     And   Uv.Attr_Id    = Att.Attr_Id
     And   Att.Attr_Code = 'JDE_PAY_TERMS'
     And   Uv.Pk_Id      = poh.poh_id
     And   Uv.Used_Type  = 'PO'
     And   Attv.attr_value = Uv.attr_value
     And   Rownum < 2) Payment_Term_JDE
  from m_sys.m_po_headers poh,  MVP_ATTP_WORKLOAD MAW, m_sys.m_overview_suppliers os , m_sys.m_po_total_costs tc, m_sys.m_units u
  where POH.POH_ID = MAW.PK_ID 
  --MZ and poh.po_number like :A_PO_NUM
  and poh.proj_id = ('@{pipeline().parameters.proj_id}')
  and poh.sup_id = os.sup_id 
  and tc.poh_id(+) = poh.poh_id 
  and poh.po_supp IN (
  select max(poh1.po_supp)from m_sys.m_po_headers poh1 
  where poh1.po_number =poh.po_number and poh1.proj_id = poh.proj_id --and poh1.order_type = 'PO'
  and poh1.approved_date is not null 
  group by poh1.po_number)
  and poh.currency_id = u.unit_id
  and nvl(tc.Total_Price,0) > 0 -- only PO Total above Zero Values -- Requested by Jamie 12-nov-2024
  order by poh.po_number,poh.po_supp, maw.attp_order_seq
